structure.unit: Requirements Applicable to Underground Coal Mines; Electricity, Safety, Etc
Ventilation, Mine Gases, and Other Hazardous Conditions

text.section: The installation or use of an auxiliary fan in any mine is prohibited without the prior written approval of the Chief.
A machine-mounted scrubber and spray fan system may be used for control of coal dust and enhancement of ventilation. Such an installation is not considered an auxiliary fan.
